meta.name: get-available-resources
meta.description: Detect host inventory and effective CPU, memory, disk, scheduler, container, and accelerator limits when a user asks for resource-aware planning or before a clearly resource-sensitive local workload. Produces a redacted JSON snapshot and conservative planning helpers without stress tests or assuming visible host hardware is usable.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检测主机资源限制并输出JSON快照
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要了解本地机器资源限制后再运行任务
copy.tagline_en: Detect host resource limits and output JSON snapshot
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to know your local machine's resource limits before running tasks

howto.what: 在开始计算密集任务前,Claude会先检测你电脑的CPU、内存、磁盘和GPU等资源,生成一个 .claude_resources.json 文件,里面包含资源快照,并给出并行处理、GPU加速、大数据处理等策略建议。
howto.when: 当用户提出计算密集或对资源敏感的任务(如大数据分析、模型训练、并行处理)时触发,Claude会先检测资源再执行。

say.text: 我要分析一个50GB的数据集,先看看内存够不够。
say.note: 触发资源检测,并根据结果建议内存策略。

say.text: 我要训练神经网络,检测一下有没有可用的GPU。
say.note: 检测GPU后端,并推荐对应加速库。

say.text: 想并行处理1万个文件,告诉我该用几个worker。
say.note: 根据CPU核心数给出建议worker数。

howto.what_en: When a compute-intensive task begins, Claude detects CPU, memory, disk, and GPU resources, writes a .claude_resources.json snapshot, and suggests strategies such as parallel processing, GPU acceleration, and handling large data.
howto.when_en: Triggers at the start of compute-intensive or resource-sensitive tasks, e.g., large data analysis, model training, or parallel processing, before running the workload.

say_en.text: I need to analyze a 50GB dataset. Check if memory is sufficient.
say_en.note: Triggers resource detection and recommends a memory strategy.

say_en.text: I want to train a neural network. Detect available GPU backends.
say_en.note: Checks GPU and recommends acceleration libraries.

say_en.text: I plan to process 10,000 files in parallel. How many workers should I use?
say_en.note: Suggests worker count based on CPU cores.
